name: GARDEN
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: A melody garden that plays itself, tended by a gardener
description: GARDEN turns the FM-1 into a melody garden. Press a key and a seed goes in at that pitch. Over minutes it sprouts, grows a phrase in the garden's scale, flowers with bells, goes to seed on the plots around it, withers and leaves compost that hums. A gardener with a name and a mood waters, prunes and plants favourites. Bees cross flowers into hybrids, a rabbit nibbles sprouts, rain speeds everything up and frost takes the weak. Every plant has a name and parents, all kept across power-offs. It plays itself from power-on, on AMB-1's pad, bells, echo and plate reverb.
credits: Engine from AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
